description:
Hushfeed v0.46.0 targets global TikTok 47.0.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

The Hushfeed entry is back at the top of Settings and privacy. Feed filtering, downloads, playback speed, feed overlays, the share sheet, Inbox, Feature Gate Lab and diagnostics now use reviewed 47.0.3 boundaries.

Validation: 1441 runtime tests passed locally, plus 244 patch tests. Both Android lint checks passed. The bundle carries 91 patches and all three nonempty DEX payloads. Every patch applied with zero failures to TikTok 47.0.3 and the retained 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures, with no manifest changes. The dedicated S22 acceptance pass confirmed all 16 probe-visible hook families and restored the changed settings. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
